_note: Everything here is read or created inside the learner's own namespace; the only cross-namespace step asks about kube-system and expects to be refused. The RoleBinding names its ServiceAccount subject exactly (system:serviceaccount:<ns>:viewer-bot), so it is applied through envsubst with SESSION_NAMESPACE from the session env.

steps.run: oc auth can-i get pods -n kube-system || true
oc describe rolebinding $(oc get rolebindings -o name | head -1 | cut -d/ -f2)
oc auth can-i get pods --as=system:serviceaccount:$SESSION_NAMESPACE:viewer-bot || true
oc auth can-i delete pods --as=system:serviceaccount:$SESSION_NAMESPACE:viewer-bot || true
